name: Exp_AFL_WinnerV2
summary: This EA trades based on the AFL_WinnerV2 custom indicator, which produces color-based momentum signals (values 0-3). It opens buy positions when the indicator shifts to bullish momentum (value 3) and sell positions when it shifts to bearish momentum (value 0), with configurable signal confirmation and position closing logic. Position sizing uses a money management system with multiple modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标AFL_WinnerV2进行交易，该指标产生基于颜色的动量信号（值0-3）。当指标转向看涨动量（值3）时开多仓，转向看跌动量（值0）时开空仓，具有可配置的信号确认和平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于AFL_WinnerV2指标的动量跟踪策略。入场条件分为两类：第一类是当指标值变为3（看涨）且前一柱不为3时触发做多信号，第二类是当指标值变为0（看跌）且前一柱不为0时触发做空信号，这两类信号可分别通过BuyPosOpen1/2和SellPosOpen1/2开关独立控制。出场条件包括：当指标值大于1时关闭空头仓位，当指标值小于2时关闭多头仓位，同样可通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose开关控制。仓位管理采用了五种模式：固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比、基于扣除亏损后的余额百分比以及基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金百分比。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险收益比为1:2。策略使用了新K柱检测机制避免重复信号，但缺乏滑点过滤和扩展点差过滤，在波动剧烈的市场中可能面临额外风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a momentum-following approach based on the AFL_WinnerV2 indicator. Entry conditions are divided into two categories: the first triggers a buy signal when the indicator value becomes 3 (bullish) and the previous bar was not 3, and the second triggers a sell signal when the indicator value becomes 0 (bearish) and the previous bar was not 0, with both signal types independently controllable via BuyPosOpen1/2 and SellPosOpen1/2 switches. Exit conditions include closing short positions when the indicator value exceeds 1 and closing long positions when the indicator value falls below 2, also controllable via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose switches. Position sizing employs five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, balance minus loss percentage, and free margin minus loss percentage. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk ratio (default 0.1), with stop loss set at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated signals, but lacks slippage filtering and spread filtering, which may pose additional risks in highly volatile markets.

parameters.description_en: Money management ratio parameter, controls position sizing

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description_en: Price type applied to the indicator

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Bar index used to retrieve trading signal

pros: 提供了多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
入场和出场信号可独立开关控制，策略配置粒度细致
采用新K柱检测机制避免同一柱内重复交易
止损止盈设置合理，风险收益比为1:2
支持多时间框架分析，指标时间框架可独立于图表周期
pros_en: Offers multiple money management modes with high flexibility to suit different risk preferences
Entry and exit signals can be independently toggled, providing fine-grained strategy configuration
Implements new bar detection to prevent repeated trades within the same bar
Reasonable stop loss and take profit settings with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio
Supports multi-timeframe analysis with indicator timeframe independent of chart period
cons: 缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能导致不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点偏大，可能不适合所有品种和市场条件
依赖自定义指标AFL_WinnerV2，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号可靠性
没有最大持仓数量限制，可能在连续信号中过度开仓
SignalBar为0时跳过新K柱检测，可能导致同柱内重复交易
cons_en: Lacks spread filtering mechanism, which may lead to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments and market conditions
Depends on the custom AFL_WinnerV2 indicator whose logic is opaque, making signal reliability hard to verify
No maximum position count limit, potentially leading to over-trading on consecutive signals
When SignalBar is 0, new bar detection is skipped, which may cause repeated trades within the same bar
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提高交易安全性
添加移动止损或追踪止盈功能，以更好地保护浮盈
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and maximum position count limits to improve trading safety
Implement trailing stop or dynamic take-profit functionality to better protect floating profits

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能遭遇大幅滑点
没有最大持仓限制，连续信号可能导致过度暴露
SignalBar=0时跳过新K柱检查可能产生重复交易风险
risk_points_en: Lack of spread filtering may cause significant slippage in low-liquidity markets
No maximum position limit means consecutive signals could lead to excessive exposure
Skipping new bar check when SignalBar=0 may produce duplicate trade risk
